0x001390.en: 「I told you to stay outta my way!」

0x0013E0.en: 「Outta my way! You're in my way!」

0x0014A3.en: 「Right then, let's give it a go!」

0x001512.en: 「Machine God or not, you ain't invincible!/ I'll smash you up!」

0x001574.en: 「The Cybuster, huh.../ Langran, what a thing you built.」

0x0015DF.en: 「Man, a Machine God really is a nasty foe!/　Gotta think of a counter...」

0x00164A.en: 「Don't push it, kid!/ Sit back and stay quiet!」

0x001694.en: 「A surface girl, eh./ Real oddball you are,/ sticking your neck in a place like this.」

0x00170C.en: 「Fighting a kid ain't my style./ Not that you'd run if I told you to.」

0x001777.en: 「The Gaddess, huh.../ Nasty foe, but I've gotta deal with it.」

0x0017D0.en: 「Quite a looker, but a surface dweller, eh.../ Really doing me no favors.」

0x001847.en: 「Believe it or not,/　I'm gentle with the ladies./　If you're gonna run, now's the time.」

0x0018B9.en: 「Can't let a monster like that run loose!/ I'll take it down!!」

0x00190F.en: 「That fool Louzorl!/　What's he thinking, reviving a thing like that!」

0x001971.en: 「God of Destruction, my foot!/ That's just a monster!」

0x0019C1.en: 「No fun unless you've got some backbone.」

0x0019FE.en: 「I'll show you what I'm made of!」

0x001B05.en: 「Doing whatever you please.../ I'll pay you back for it!」

0x001C2C.en: 「Gwah!/ ...Hey, I might not hold up here.」

0x001C70.en: 「You bastard!/ Like hell I'll go down!!」

0x001CBA.en: 「Ngh~... That one stung, I'll tell ya!!」

0x001D84.en: 「Uwoh!?/ This Cybuster's really/ no joke at all!」

0x001DED.en: 「Wh-what the!?/ Why's it got power like this!?」

0x001E34.en: 「Gwah!!/ Th-that's the Gaddess for ya... this is rough.」

0x001F70.en: 「Hah!!/ You think this is enough to beat me!!」

0x001FC3.en: 「Ow ow.../ You've got some guts, punk!!」

0x00203B.en: 「Yow! Seems you're better than I thought.」

0x002075.en: 「Tch,/ looks like I gotta get serious now.」

0x002112.en: 「Whoa!?/ Small as you are, you play dirty.」

0x00215F.en: 「Ow ow.../ Pretty face, but you fight nasty.」

0x0021AF.en: 「Ngh!/ So you're as strong as you look, huh!」

0x002243.en: 「You think that stuff works on me!!」

0x00226E.en: 「You call that an attack?/ How pathetic.」

0x0022BE.en: 「No good, no good./ That won't even kill a bug.」

0x002308.en: 「Hahaha!/ That's not working, not working at all!」

0x0023D9.en: 「What was that? You serious right now?」

0x002410.en: 「You thought that'd do anything?/ Little lady.」

0x002463.en: 「Hmph, so the Gaddess is only this much.」

0x0024A9.en: 「Heh, all bark and no bite,/　same goes for this Volkruss.」

0x0024F9.en: 「Gahaha!/ As if you'd hit me, ya klutz!」

0x00267F.en: 「Showing your hand too much. So green.」

0x0026B0.en: 「Give it up, missy. I'm the better pilot.」

0x0026ED.en: 「Machine God or not,/ if it can't hit me, it's nothing!」

0x00281B.en: 「What the!/ Where're you attacking from, ya moron!!」

0x002871.en: 「One more time, or I won't be happy!」

0x0028A2.en: 「Come on, come on,/ space out and I'll hit ya again!!」

0x0029E8.en: 「Alright! Let me lay one on ya!」

0x002A1C.en: 「It's not over yet!/ Never let your guard down!」

0x002B5F.en: 「Open your eyes and take a good look at my power!」

0x002C15.en: 「Alright, let me lay one on ya!」
